text:
Ivy S.: Noticed multiple PM follow-ups slipping again. Proposal: a concise 'ownership ladder' + compact timeline + light verification rules. Want to keep friction minimal.

Ben L.: Agree. Can you sketch the ladder?

Ivy S.: Ladder idea (minimal): Owner -> Team Steward -> Resilience Lead -> Oncall IC. Each level only activated when previous misses SLA.

Harper - oncall: That maps well to who can action quickly. What SLAs are you thinking?

Ivy S.: Compact timeline (T0 = postmortem published):
```
T+48h: Owner ack or auto-assign to Team Steward
T+7d: short status update (thread + tracker)
T+21d: verification started
T+60d: recurrence check + executive note if still open
```

Ben L.: 21d instead of 30d is interesting — forces earlier verification. Add AcceptanceCriteria and EvidenceLink fields so closures are objective.

incident-bot: [automated] I can enforce ack windows and post reminders. Need config: ack_window_hours, reminder_offsets, escalation_sequence, notify_channel.

Data Ops (Marta): For recurrence detection, can we compute a simple "recurrence score" based on tag frequency + service hit rate? If score > 2.5 mark as "systemic" and require Resilience Lead review.

Harper - oncall: Also propose a paired IC rotation: primary (weekly) + shadow (biweekly). Shadow overlaps for handover. Primary handles weekly triage of overdue actions.

Ivy S.: Implementation notes: keep the tracker as a tiny issue list (tracker ticket per action). incident-bot creates a followup-ticket when SLA missed by >7d and copies fields: Action, Owner, AcceptanceCriteria, RecurrenceTag.

Ben L.: And add small "heatmap" column: Low/Med/High computed from Priority + RecurrenceScore so weekly triage sorts by heat.

Data Ops (Marta): I'll prototype a recurrence scorer endpoint that returns score and suggested tags. We can call it from the postmortem flow.

incident-bot: [automated] Proposed default config: ack_window_hours=48, reminder_offsets_hours=[48,168], escalation_sequence=[owner,team_steward,resilience_lead,oncall_ic], auto_followup_after_days=7, notify_channel="#eng-oncall".

Harper - oncall: Pilot plan: run on next 10 postmortems, require AcceptanceCriteria on every action, and require EvidenceLink for closures. I'll set up the rotation calendar and wire bot reminders. ETA: next Monday (1855080000).

Ivy S.: Metrics to evaluate pilot: percent of actions acked within 48h, percent with AcceptanceCriteria, 7/21/60 closure rates, number of systemic flags.

Ben L.: If folks want in, react or DM me. Happy to help tune the heatmap thresholds. :thumbsup:
